settings.intro:
The outpost went dark three hours ago.
Find the red key, get to the lab terminal, open the boss gate — and get out alive.

WASD move · mouse look · E use · F flashlight · 1-6 weapons
settings.objective: Find the exit. Hint: a red key opens the armory.

props.text: Mission: find the exit.  [E] opens doors, [F] flashlight, [R] reload.

props.lines:
You made it! The terminal on the north wall opens the boss gate.
But it will trip the alarm… be ready.
The red key? Up the tower in the courtyard.

rules.text: Reach the boss arena north of the courtyard and escape.

props.text: Toxic pit — jump over it or go around.
